documents.title: Helios Insurance — RFP for claims-processing support (180 seats)

clauses.title: Participants
clauses.text: This RFP has been issued to six (6) shortlisted vendors through the procurement portal.

clauses.title: Liability
clauses.text: The Supplier's liability under this agreement shall be unlimited, including indirect and consequential losses.

clauses.title: Payment
clauses.text: Undisputed invoices shall be paid within one hundred and twenty (120) days of receipt.

clauses.title: Transition
clauses.text: Full service go-live is required within four (4) weeks of award for all 180 seats.

clauses.title: Service credits
clauses.text: A service credit of 10% of the monthly fee applies for each SLA missed, uncapped.

clauses.title: Submission
clauses.text: Responses are due within eight (8) calendar days of issue.

documents.title: Orchid Retail — email: add Hindi chat support

clauses.title: Request
clauses.text: Expand the existing customer-support team by 12 seats to cover Hindi chat, from 1 November.

clauses.title: Budget
clauses.text: Budget approved by our COO, Ms. R. Shah, who will sign the change order.

clauses.title: Terms
clauses.text: Same rates and 45-day payment terms as the current statement of work.

clauses.title: Referral
clauses.text: Referred by our implementation partner for consumer billing-dispute handling, 60 seats.

clauses.title: Buyer
clauses.text: Sahyadri Power Distribution is a subsidiary of the state electricity board.

clauses.title: Commercials
clauses.text: Payment on monthly certification by the user department; L1 (lowest price) selection.
